; Base model, without SDE processing. $PROBLEM EX4model1
$INPUT ID TIME DV MDV EVID AMT CMT AGE SEX BSA
$DATA sde_ex4_base.dat IGNORE @
$SUBROUTINE ADVAN6 TOL 6 DP
$MODEL COMP=(CENTRAL) COMP=(PERIPH) COMP=(ISR)
$THETA (0 0.1) ; ISR0 $THETA (0 0.6) ; W
$OMEGA 0.5 ; ISR0
$SIGMA 1 FIX
$PK T12A=4.52 ALPHA=LOG(2)/T12A FRACA=0.78 FRACB=1-FRACA T12B=0.14*AGE+29.2 BETA=LOG(2)/T12B K21=(FRACA*BETA+FRACB*ALPHA)/(FRACA+FRACB) K10=(ALPHA*BETA)/K21 K12=ALPHA+BETA-K21-K10 V1=1 IF (SEX.EQ.0) V1=1.92*BSA+0.64 IF (SEX.EQ.1) V1=1.11*BSA+2.04
TVISR0=THETA(1) ISR0=TVISR0*EXP(ETA(1))
F1=ISR0/K10 F2=K12*F1/K21 F3=ISR0
ISR=A(3) ISRV=0
$DES DADT(1) = A(3)-K10*A(1)-K12*A(1)+K21*A(2) DADT(2) = K12*A(1)-K21*A(2) DADT(3) = 0
$ERROR IPRED=A(1)/V1 IRES=DV-IPRED W=THETA(2) IWRES=IRES/W Y=IPRED+W*EPS(1)
$ESTIMATION MAXEVALS=9999 METHOD=1 INTERACTION NOABORT SIGDIGITS=3 PRINT=5
$COVARIANCE
$TABLE ID TIME EVID IPRED IRES IWRES TVISR0 W ISR ISRV AGE SEX BSA NOPRINT ONEHEADER FILE=sde_ex4_base.tab
